    <script>
        tailwind.config = {
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    fontFamily: {
                        sans: ['"Inter"', 'ui-sans-serif', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'],
                        serif: ['"Playfair Display"', 'serif'],
                    },
                    colors: {
                        obsidian: 'oklch(15% 0.02 240)',
                        'golden-hour': 'oklch(75% 0.18 45)',
                        'light-thread': 'oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1)',
                    },
                    backgroundImage: {
                        'obsidian-gradient': 'linear-gradient(145deg, oklch(20% 0.02 240), oklch(10% 0.02 240))',
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
    <style>
        :root {
            --obsidian: oklch(15% 0.02 240);
            --golden-hour: oklch(75% 0.18 45);
            --light-thread: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--obsidian);
            color: white;
            margin: 0;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .optical-breach {
            position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
            z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
        }

        .video-layer {
            width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;
            mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 120% at 85% 50%, black 45%, transparent 70%);
            -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 120% at 85% 50%, black 45%, transparent 70%);
            transform: scale(1.05); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        @supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) {
            .video-layer {
                animation: diaphragmOpen linear both;
                animation-timeline: scroll(block root);
            }
        }

        @keyframes diaphragmOpen {
            0% { mask-size: 100% 100%; transform: scale(1.05); }
            100% { mask-size: 150% 150%; transform: scale(1); }
        }

        .lens-flare {
            position: fixed; width: 60vw; height: 60vh;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--golden-hour) 0%, transparent 70%);
            filter: blur(100px); opacity: 0.15; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: screen;
        }

        .glass-panel {
            background: oklch(15% 0.02 240 / 0.6);
            backdrop-filter: blur(50px) contrast(1.1) brightness(0.8);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(50px) contrast(1.1) brightness(0.8);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--light-thread);
        }

        .shutter-btn {
            position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--obsidian);
            border: 1px solid var(--light-thread);
            box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), inset -1px -1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); transform: translateZ(0);
        }

        .shutter-btn::after {
            content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 0%, transparent 60%);
            opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.1); transition: opacity 0.1s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; pointer-events: none;
        }

        .shutter-btn:hover {
            border-color: var(--golden-hour);
            box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), inset -1px -1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), 0 0 25px oklch(75% 0.18 45 / 0.3);
        }

        .shutter-btn:active::after {
            opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); transition: opacity 0s, transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .focus-container:hover .focus-item { filter: blur(8px) grayscale(50%); opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.98); }
        .focus-container .focus-item { transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); will-change: filter, opacity, transform; }
        .focus-container .focus-item:hover { filter: blur(0) grayscale(0%); opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.02) translateZ(20px); z-index: 10; }

        .obsidian-card {
            background: rgba(37, 37, 37, 0.8); border: 1px solid var(--light-thread);
            box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), inset -2px -2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 10px 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            backdrop-filter: blur(5px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(5px); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
        }

        .obsidian-card::before {
            content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 50%; height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(37, 37, 37, 0.03), transparent);
            transform: skewX(-20deg); transition: left 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .obsidian-card:hover::before { left: 200%; }

        .text-golden { color: var(--golden-hour); text-shadow: 0 0 20px oklch(75% 0.18 45 / 0.4); }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--obsidian); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--light-thread); border-radius: 10px; }

        .hud-frame { position: relative; border: 1px solid transparent; }
        .hud-frame::before, .hud-frame::after {
            content: ''; position: absolute; width: 15px; height: 15px;
            border: 1px solid var(--golden-hour); opacity: 0.5;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .hud-frame::before { top: 0; left: 0; border-right: none; border-bottom: none; }
        .hud-frame::after { bottom: 0; right: 0; border-left: none; border-top: none; }
        .hud-frame:hover::before, .hud-frame:hover::after { width: 35px; height: 35px; opacity: 1; }
        .hud-frame:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.01); }

        .clip-edge { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 20px), calc(100% - 20px) 100%, 0 100%); }
        .clip-edge-reverse { clip-path: polygon(20px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 20px); }

        @keyframes marquee { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
        .animate-marquee { animation: marquee 30s linear infinite; width: max-content; }
        .animate-marquee:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }

        .css-grid-bg {
            background-size: 30px 30px;
            background-image: 
                linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
        }
    </style>
